svg.title: Itojinsei — The Iron Loom. Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Magnet classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 10 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Taut Filament forks into Razor Strands then Severing Lattice, or Threadbound Vigor then Weaver Ascendant. Tangling Snare forks into Constricting Coils then Iron Cocoon, or Conductive Seam then Galvanic Marionette. No paths converge. Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu.

the two-row Suppression capstone carries none","rationale":"Nine supported rows sit on five casts, all cooldown 7: four Magnet Bukijutsu Damage rows (Iron Web Entrapment 45; Wire Blast Plus, Spiraling Wires and Lightning Threads 40), two 35% self Increase Damage Given rows (Spiraling Wires, Eternal Embrace) that compound on a hit both cover, two universal Decrease Damage Given rows (Wire Blast Plus 30%, an ally-hazard circle; Eternal Embrace 35%) and one 35% Increase Damage Taken row on Lightning Threads. Taut Filament answers \"How do I make my own wires cut harder: a keener strand, or a stronger hand?\": the Severing Lattice burst sets up Lightning Threads' exposure (Razor Strands +3%, 35 \u2192 38%) and pays off +2 Damage on every Magnet strike (no kit tier crossed), and the Weaver Ascendant route raises both self buffs to 43% for the two rounds after each cast. Tangling Snare answers \"How do I bind the target: blunt its blows, or lay it open to ours?\": the Iron Cocoon route takes both suppression rows +10% (\u00d70.725), and the Galvanic Marionette route takes Lightning Threads' exposure +10% (35 \u2192 45%, \u00d71.074) with a +2% suppression rider because its own tag reaches one row. The kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row, so there is no self-defensive route. Structure, names and edges unchanged (01\u219202\u219203, 01\u219204\u219205, 06\u219207\u219208, 06\u219209\u219210). Damage route: the pre-batch +5 route (Razor Strands +2, Severing Lattice +3 Damage) lifted Wire Blast Plus, Spiraling Wires and Lightning Threads 40 \u2192 45 (a full tier) and Iron Web Entrapment, the kit's stun line, 45 \u2192 50 (semi-nuke to Nuke); the batch first cut it to a +1/+1 steady edge, and the consistency pass (R9\u2032) makes Razor Strands a +3% Increase Damage Taken setup on Lightning Threads and Severing Lattice a +2 Damage payoff, a burst at the same +2 (45 \u2192 47, 40 \u2192 42). Amplifier: Threadbound Vigor +3% \u2192 +2% and Weaver Ascendant +5% \u2192 +4% Increase Damage Given; Weaver Ascendant drops its +2% Increase Damage Taken rider. Roster pass: Iron Cocoon drops its +2% Increase Damage Taken rider; the rest of the Tangling Snare branch keeps its Draft 4 values.","Maxima over every legal allocation: Damage +2 (in the kit 40 \u2192 42, 45 \u2192 47; no kit tier crossed), Increase Damage Given +8%, Decrease Damage Given +10%, Increase Damage Taken +10%. Not jointly attainable. Top offensive package (Increase Damage Given \u00d7 Taken \u00d7 flat Damage, all windows live): \u00d71.147 (Weaver Ascendant + Razor Strands: both self buffs 43%, exposure 38%), below Blood-Enchanted Eyes' \u00d71.234; the burst build with Threadbound Vigor is \u00d71.138. Off-kit Magnet Damage rows are unverified; a 50 EP one would reach 52.","Sized by leverage, not printed totals. The two self buffs compound on a hit both cover, so +8% takes \u00d71.82 to \u00d72.04 (+12%); +10% would reach \u00d72.10. The burst's +2 EP is +5% on a 40 EP strike and +4.4% on Iron Web Entrapment (formula damage is linear in EP: tags.ts powerEffect), on every cast; Razor Strands' setup adds \u00d71.022 (Lightning Threads 35 \u2192 38%) to the strikes in the two rounds after Lightning Threads. R9\u2032 setup test for Razor Strands: Increase Damage Given would be a stacking twin of Threadbound Vigor (a legal fourth for Weaver Ascendant, 01+02+04+05 at +10\u201311% on the two compounding buffs, +10% with a +2% setup); Decrease Damage Given does nothing for the route's hits; Increase Damage Taken passes: it shares Lightning Threads' row with Conductive Seam but sits in the other branch, so no capstone allocation stacks them, the capstone-free 01+02+06+09 reaches 43% against Galvanic Marionette's 45% (no near-tie), and the top package stays \u00d71.147. The two Decrease Damage Given rows reduce in sequence: +10% takes an enemy under both from \u00d70.455 to \u00d70.33 of its damage (\u00d70.725), the value approved for Blood-Enchanted Eyes' Red Pestilence on the same universal 30%/35% pair (RUL-2026-10-04-001), which is this tree's reason for +10% on two compounding rows; Iron Cocoon carries no rider, lighter than Red Pestilence's +3% Decrease Damage Taken. Increase Damage Taken has one row but multiplies every matching hit on the target, so it carries both the exposure route and the burst's setup.","Filters (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73): Spiraling Wires' self buff (Bukijutsu/Speed/Strength, no element) reaches every Bukijutsu-typed or element-less hit, weapons and basic attacks included; Eternal Embrace's reaches Lightning, Magnet, Wind and element-less hits; both cover the four kit strikes, and the 25% + 0.15/level bloodline passive multiplies last. Both Decrease Damage Given rows list all four stat types and no element, so they reach every non-pierce hit; Lightning Threads' exposure lists Lightning, Magnet, Wind and None.","Delivery (\u00a73b, \u00a74b): every cast is cooldown 7 and every percentage row is live the two rounds after its cast, never on its own hit. Spiraling Wires (60 AP) and Eternal Embrace (40 AP) open both self buffs in one round; Wire Blast Plus and Eternal Embrace do the same for both suppression rows. The four Damage casts are 60 AP, one per turn, so two of the other three strikes fit a self-buff window and Spiraling Wires is never under its own buff. All five jutsu are OTHER_USER.","Fourth purchases: Burst takes Tangling Snare or Threadbound Vigor; Amplifier takes Razor Strands or Tangling Snare; Suppression takes Taut Filament or Conductive Seam; Exposure takes Constricting Coils or Taut Filament. The two all-offense builds share Taut Filament, Razor Strands (exposure 38%) and Threadbound Vigor and differ only in the capstone: a 40 EP kit strike under both buffs is 42 \u00d7 1.39\u00b2 \u2248 81 (Severing Lattice) against 40 \u00d7 1.43\u00b2 \u2248 82 (Weaver Ascendant), and over one cooldown cycle (Spiraling Wires + Eternal Embrace, Iron Web Entrapment and one 40 EP strike in the window, one after it) about 256 against 254 on kit strikes; the burst keeps two more EP on every Magnet hit outside the windows (42 against 40), the amplifier reaches weapons, basic attacks and element-less hits inside them. The two control builds with the sibling Hidden Art share Tangling Snare, Constricting Coils and Conductive Seam and differ only in the capstone: Iron Cocoon gives suppression 40%/45% (enemy \u00d70.33) with exposure 40%, Galvanic Marionette 37%/42% (\u00d70.365) with exposure 45%."],"risks":["Self-buff reach: both self Increase Damage Given rows reach beyond the kit (Spiraling Wires: any Bukijutsu-typed or element-less hit; Eternal Embrace: any Lightning, Magnet, Wind or element-less hit), so the +8% maximum also raises matching normal jutsu, weapons and basic attacks in each window; where both windows overlap they compound (\u00d71.43\u00b2 \u2248 \u00d72.04) before the passive. Uptime not simulated.","Ally hazard: Wire Blast Plus row 1 (Decrease Damage Given) is an OTHER_USER AOE_CIRCLE_SPAWN with friendly fire none (=ALL), so allies in the radius-1 circle also receive it, up to 40% at the Suppression maximum; the caster is never a target (SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a74b). Eternal Embrace's row is friendly fire ENEMIES. Positioning decides.","Exposure concentration: one row (Lightning Threads, 60 AP, single target, 2 rounds) reaches 45% (\u00d71.074 over base) and multiplies every matching non-pierce hit on the target, the party's included; on the caster's hits it compounds with the self buffs. Party value was not simulated.","Damage: +2 EP on four Magnet rows keeps Iron Web Entrapment's stun line at High tier (47) in the kit. Off-kit NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT Magnet Damage rows are unverified; a 50 EP one would reach 52, the 50 \u2192 52 flagged for Blood-Enchanted Eyes, Shakunetsu Sakura and Houkyuken (Houkyuken's 50 EP Magnetic Pulse Strike is bloodline-locked, so an Itojinsei owner cannot cast it). The hits are formula-calculated and the self buffs and passive multiply them, so +2 EP is not +2 damage. Not simulated.","Eternal Embrace delivery: the self buff is realized on the caster at cast time (actions.ts 980\u20131004/1060\u20131075; SOURCE_MECHANICS \u00a73b) whenever the circle spawn has a legal target, an ally included; the Decrease Damage Given row (friendly fire ENEMIES) hits each living enemy in the circle once. Buffprevent is unsupported.","Classification: Magnet is shared with Houkyuken (expected under RUL-2026-10-03-005). The Damage rows, Eternal Embrace's self buff and Lightning Threads' exposure carry Magnet; Spiraling Wires' self buff and both Decrease Damage Given rows carry no element, so the Suppression route and half the Amplifier depend on the proposed jutsu-classification resolver (ENGINE_GAP_REGISTER G1). Off-kit Magnet coverage is unverified.","No self-defensive route: the kit has no Decrease Damage Taken, Reflect, Lifesteal or Heal row (the 15% Lightning Decrease Damage Taken passive is not a jutsu row); stun, redirection, decrease-heal and buffprevent receive nothing.","Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in RANKED_PVP and RANKED_SPARRING. g.text: Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Bonuses apply to matching supported tags on all Magnet jutsu. Combat scopes stay unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDG: Decrease Damage Given · IDT: Increase Damage Taken
FINAL TAG VALUES ON THE ITOJINSEI KIT
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed behavior: needs a jutsu-classification potency resolver. The current resolver matches each effect's own elements.
14 legal four-skill allocations · 4 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
Fable proposal — 2026-10-04 batch rebalance / Magnet classification / forked tree
